CANONICAL_TITLE: Metaphors We Think With: The Role of Metaphor in Reasoning

WHAT_IT_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT: Generalisation to expert technical readers; effect stability (see L3-006)
EXACT_CLAIM_BOUNDARY: Used as evidence that metaphor-induced inference can be covert -> false-inference must be measured, not self-reported
LIMITATIONS: Social-policy stimuli; effect contested by L3-006

LIMITATIONS: Same paradigm as L3-004; contested by L3-006

AUTHOR_OR_BODY: Gerard J. Steen; W. Gudrun Reijnierse; Christian Burgers
